youtube_search.purpose: Discovery (flat via yt-dlp): views, duration, channel ID, title; no dates. Filters: sp=EgIQAQ== videos, sp=EgIYAQ== under 4 min.

youtube_hashtag_shorts.purpose: Shorts discovery: IDs and views only; channel comes from full metadata.

youtube_channel_videos.purpose: Long-form baseline: last 30-40 uploads with views and approximate dates (youtubetab:approximate_date), one request.

youtube_channel_shorts.purpose: Shorts baseline: views only, newest first, no dates.

youtube_watch.purpose: Full metadata, captions, comments, media (yt-dlp); the raw HTML's ytInitialPlayerResponse is the independent view-count check.
